android_app.checksum_note: Check the downloaded file against this SHA-256 checksum before installing.
android_app.intro: Download the Easy-Post Mobile Companion for Android directly, then pair it with this desktop to track and manage shipments from a phone.
android_app.needs_production: The Android app pairs with the production version. Activate a production licence to download and pair it.
android_app.play_soon: Coming soon to Google Play. This direct download is an early-access build for production licence holders while the Play Store listing is finalised.
android_app.reinstall_note: This early-access build is signed independently of the Google Play release. Reinstalling from Google Play may be required once the listing is live; pairing carries across, so nothing is lost.
android_app.steps:
1. Download the APK onto the Android phone, or transfer it across.
2. Open the file, then allow installation from this source if prompted.
3. Open Easy-Post Mobile Companion and choose Pair.
4. Generate a pairing code under Tools then Pair mobile app, and scan it.
android_app.title: Android app

connect_agents.allow_spending_label: Allow agents to request purchases (still needs your approval below)
connect_agents.approvals_intro: Purchases an agent has requested. Nothing has been bought. Details below come from EasyPost, not from the agent.
connect_agents.clients_intro: These MCP clients were found on this computer. Connecting one adds an entry to its configuration file; the existing file is backed up first and nothing else in it is changed.
connect_agents.confirm_spend_body:
Buy {carrier} for {amount} {currency} in {mode} mode?

This spends real money if production mode is active.
connect_agents.manual_intro: For any client not listed above, add this to its MCP configuration. Most clients nest servers under "mcpServers"; VS Code uses "servers".
connect_agents.no_clients: No MCP clients were detected. Use the manual setup below.
connect_agents.relay_config_label: Paste this into your AI client's MCP configuration. Most clients nest servers under "mcpServers"; VS Code uses "servers".
connect_agents.relay_group: Connect an AI client (via secure relay)
connect_agents.relay_intro: This app reaches AI clients through a secure relay: it makes an outbound connection only — nothing listens for incoming connections on your Mac. The relay never sees your EasyPost key and never runs a tool; every tool runs here, and buying still needs your approval below.
connect_agents.relay_optin_intro: Optionally reach this app from another computer, or from a client that only accepts a URL, through a secure relay. The local option above is the default and needs no network. The relay makes an outbound connection only, never sees your EasyPost key and never runs a tool; buying still needs your approval below.
connect_agents.relay_regenerate_confirm_: This immediately disconnects any AI client using the current token. You will need to paste the new configuration into each client. Continue?
connect_agents.relay_status_running: Connected — AI clients can reach this app while it is open.
connect_agents.relay_status_stopped: Not connected. Turn on “Enable AI agent access” above to start.
connect_agents.relay_token_warning: Treat this configuration like a password: the token lets an AI client read your shipping data and shop rates (never spend) while this app is open. Regenerate it if it is ever exposed.
connect_agents.relay_url_form_label: Or, for a client that only accepts a URL (no headers):
connect_agents.safety_explainer: Agents can read your data, verify addresses and shop rates without asking. They can never buy anything directly: a purchase becomes a request you approve here, showing details fetched from EasyPost rather than whatever the agent said. Anything over these limits is refused outright rather than offered for approval. Set a limit to 0 to remove it.
connect_agents.title: Connect AI Agents
connect_agents.unsupported_body: AI agent connectivity over MCP is currently supported only in the direct-download version of Easy-Post Desktop. Connecting an agent requires another application to launch a helper process from inside this installation and to write to configuration files belonging to other apps, neither of which a Microsoft Store package is permitted to do reliably.
connect_agents.unsupported_link: The direct-download build is available at easy-post.spencerfields.com. Everything else in the app works identically in both versions.
connect_agents.verified_note: These details were re-fetched from EasyPost using only the identifiers the agent supplied. If this is not what you expected, reject it.
